use_cases: Creating animated hero section headlines with 3D wave effects
Building engaging loading states with shimmering text animation
Adding visual emphasis to call-to-action text elements
Designing eye-catching feature highlights in product pages
Creating decorative animated typography for marketing materials
ai_summary: TextShimmerWave is a Framer Motion-powered React component that creates an animated text effect where each character shimmers and waves with 3D perspective transforms. Characters animate with staggered timing through Z-axis depth, X/Y translation, scale, and Y-axis rotation, while transitioning colors from a base gray to a gradient highlight color, producing a dynamic neon-like wave effect ideal for hero sections and impactful typography displays.
